# tebib_iam_policy_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a policy (customer or TebibHost-managed) to a user, group, service account or role, for the whole organization or for one project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_iam_policy_attachment" "ci_vm_operator" {
  policy     = tebib_iam_policy.vm_operator.id
  principal  = tebib_iam_service_account.ci.trn
  project_id = "p-def456" # leave out for the whole organization
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy` (String) Policy ID, TRN or name, e.g. `tebib_iam_policy.ci.id` or a managed policy name like `ComputeFullAccess`. Changing it replaces the attachment.
- `principal` (String) TRN of the user, group, service account or role. Changing it replaces the attachment.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID (`o-...`). Default: the provider's `organization`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `project_id` (String) Limit the policy to this project. Default: the whole organization. Changing it replaces the attachment.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Attachment ID.
- `policy_id` (String) ID of the attached policy.
- `policy_trn` (String) TRN of the attached policy.
- `principal_type` (String) `user`, `group`, `service_account` or `role`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tebib_iam_policy_attachment.ci_vm_operator pat-abc123
```
